name: path-builder
title: Star built point by point
summary: A symmetric five-point star built with pathCreate, nine pathAppendLineTo calls and pathAppendClose, then filled and outlined.
prompt: Draw a yellow five-point star with a white outline, building the path point by point.
teaches: Start a named path at its first point with pathCreate
Add vertices with pathAppendLineTo and close the outline with pathAppendClose
Reuse one path id for a fill and an outline by drawing it twice with different paints
Fit a drawing authored at the header size to any box: a variable s = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H), a translate by half the extra space and a scale by s about the design's centre

snippets.note: pathCreate: path id 'star' starting at the top point
pathAppendLineTo: the next vertex, an inner point
pathAppendClose back to the first point
drawPath by id with the fill paint
a 3 dp white outline with round joins over the fill

check.describe: A yellow five-point star with a white outline, point up and symmetric. Resized, it scales to the shorter side and stays centred.

pitfalls: Every pathAppend* names the path it extends with `path`; pathCreate declares it with `id` and its first point
Draw the fill before the outline: the stroke is centred on the edge, so half of it would be covered by a later fill
Without strokeJoin round the outline's sharp star points become long miter spikes

Canvas coordinates are pixels of the box the host gives the document, not of the header: literal coordinates sit in the top-left and get cut off when it is resized, so scale the drawing to fit (or derive positions from componentWidth()/componentHeight())
